proof_scope: Tau human acceptance attestation verifier and project-status integration

claims.proves: Tau validates a human acceptance attestation against the exact baseline receipt digest, source commit, proof receipt digest, signer authority, decision, and timestamp policy; project-status distinguishes missing, invalid, and verified acceptance states.
claims.does_not_prove: A real human has accepted the Tau goal, provider semantic quality, production readiness, or GOAL.md completion.

capability_claims.description: Tau verifies human acceptance attestations against exact baseline/source/proof digests and reports verified vs missing vs invalid acceptance in project status.

cases.name: acceptance-attestation-verifier-accepts-exact-git-baseline
command: cd .. && mkdir -p local/agentic-evals && TAU_ACCEPTANCE_ATTESTATION_PROOF=local/agentic-evals/tau-acceptance-attestation-proof.json uv run pytest --tau-suite=all tests/test_acceptance_attestation.py::test_valid_attestation_accepts_exact_baseline_commit_and_receipt tests/test_project_status.py::test_project_status_distinguishes_verified_and_invalid_human_acceptance -q -s
